description: Initialize Next.js project with all dependencies, configure TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS, and install shadcn/ui components. Set up project structure for all 18 CIOS modules.
steps: Create Next.js project with App Router in /projects/sandbox/Carbon-Intelligence-Operating-System using: npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias '@/*' --use-npm (use defaults for all prompts, non-interactive)

Install core dependencies: @supabase/supabase-js @supabase/ssr @prisma/client @tanstack/react-table react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod recharts mapbox-gl lucide-react next-themes class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge

Initialize shadcn/ui with: npx shadcn@latest init -d (defaults). Then install components: npx shadcn@latest add button card input label select textarea checkbox radio-group switch tabs dialog sheet dropdown-menu popover command separator badge avatar tooltip scroll-area table accordion alert progress skeleton
Configure TypeScript strict mode in tsconfig.json

Create directory structure: src/app/(auth)/, src/app/(dashboard)/, src/app/(dashboard)/organization/, src/app/(dashboard)/master-data/, src/app/(dashboard)/activity-data/, src/app/(dashboard)/emission-engine/, src/app/(dashboard)/emission-factors/, src/app/(dashboard)/ai-engine/, src/app/(dashboard)/ai-roadmap/, src/app/(dashboard)/ai-simulator/, src/app/(dashboard)/digital-mrv/, src/app/(dashboard)/verification/, src/app/(dashboard)/carbon-finance/, src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/, src/app/(dashboard)/esg-disclosure/, src/app/(dashboard)/api-gateway/, src/app/(dashboard)/ai-agents/, src/app/(dashboard)/security/, src/app/(dashboard)/analytics/, src/app/(dashboard)/settings/, src/components/ui/, src/components/layout/, src/components/modules/, src/lib/, src/lib/supabase/, src/types/
Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() utility function (shadcn pattern)
Create src/lib/supabase/client.ts with Supabase browser client
Create src/lib/supabase/server.ts with Supabase server client
Create src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts with Supabase auth middleware helper
Create src/middleware.ts with Supabase auth session refresh middleware
Create .env.example with all required environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, REDIS_URL, MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN)
Create .env.local with placeholder values for development
Verify: npm run build passes, npm run lint passes
acceptance_criteria: Next.js project builds successfully with npm run build
All shadcn/ui components are installed and accessible
Directory structure for all 18 modules exists
Supabase client utilities are in place
ESLint passes with npm run lint
findings: Used Prisma 6 (v6.19.3) instead of Prisma 7 because Prisma 7 requires prisma.config.ts and a different datasource configuration pattern. Next.js version is 16.2.12 with Tailwind CSS v4. The middleware file convention shows a deprecation warning about using proxy instead, but still works. shadcn/ui also installed an extra input-group.tsx component along with the requested ones. The create-next-app tool rejected the directory name with capital letters so a temp directory approach was used.
